verdict.rationale: Gmail has a developer API ecosystem, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developers.google.com/llms.txt), and no OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. Nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented documentation; the standard human-facing REST API guides do not count as such.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
